title: Benchmark: manufacturing_process / semiconductor_capex / software_factory
body: Create redistributable or synthetic gold datasets for 3 highest-utility workflows. Score operation/status, literal and semantic evidence, numbers and periods, abstention and review workload. Separate public IR from internal manufacturing data; never commit private raw sources.

title: Track provenance of model, prompt and domain pack in every run
body: Persist exact model identifier/revision, prompt version, domain pack SHA, runtime config hash and source hash. Add migration behavior for old outputs and tests.

title: Document ingestion adapters with stable citations
body: Add TXT/HTML/PDF ingestion interfaces and source/chunk offsets. Keep raw source private. Evaluate OCR separately and avoid losing provenance.

title: Add human review workflow and conflicting-evidence handling
body: Support manual accept/correct/reject of extracted semantics; preserve initial prediction and reviewer decision without overwriting evidence.

title: Evaluate graph retrieval before adding learned traversal
body: Define cited graph-query baseline and held-out cross-domain questions; distinguish mention edges from verified relationships. Prospector implementation remains outside scope until independently justified.

title: Govern personalized domain registry and schema compatibility
body: Keep config/domain_registry.json aligned with domain_packs, enforce boundaries and review guards, check sample coverage. Document old-ID migration and extraction version pins. Changes require an issue, PR and meaningful tests.
